{"diagnosis": "Fetch shows no progress (max_addr=0x00000000, tohost FAIL 0xdead) instead of advancing through NOP memory. mem_done stays low so mem_busy never clears and fetch never completes. Root cause is line 376 combining the mem_xfer with |mem_state term and the &mem_state with mem_do_rinst term using && instead of ||, requiring both simultaneously and blocking mem_done.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -376,1 +376,1 @@
-	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) && (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
+	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) || (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
", "expected": "tohost PASS (not FAIL 0xdead) with fetch progress max_addr != 0x00000000, checksum != 563b7c10626ff25de2b3c430956c7c113e448c4efaea068f9b83a198d4322b15"}

Root cause is line 376 combining the mem_xfer with |mem_state term and the &mem_state with mem_do_rinst term using && instead of ||, requiring both simultaneously and blocking mem_done.
